Where we meet

Potpourri Stitchers gathers in members’ homes, rotating each month. We would love to have you.

Where it’s held

In a member’s home — the hostess shares her address with the group each month. Bring your own lunch; coffee, tea, and dessert are provided by the hostess.

Planning to come?

Please let the hostess know you’ll be attending so she can plan. Get in touch →

We’d love to have you. Come sit in on this group, or any of our other monthly meetings — in person or on Zoom, whichever fits your calendar. Try as many as you’re curious about. Once you’ve found the one (or three) that feel like yours, join us for just $30 a year.
